subject.title: fix: escape control chars in sanitizeBinaryOutput instead of stripping

question: Should OpenClaw change exec/session transcript sanitization to strip valid ANSI/OSC sequences and escape residual C0 control bytes, or keep the current drop-controls behavior until a broader renderer contract is designed?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes stored/model-visible transcript bytes across exec and session output paths, so automation cannot choose the product contract safely.

options.title: Strip ANSI, escape residual controls
options.body: Use the shared terminal-core ANSI helper first, then escape remaining C0 controls with tests and real exec proof.

options.title: Keep current sanitizer for now
options.body: Leave the drop-controls behavior in place and keep the linked issue open until a broader renderer or transcript contract is designed.

options.title: Accept escape-only output
options.body: Allow valid ANSI sequences to appear as bracketed fragments, accepting a rougher transcript format to make hidden bytes visible quickly.

recommendation.title: Strip ANSI, escape residual controls
recommendation.body: Use the shared terminal-core ANSI helper first, then escape remaining C0 controls with tests and real exec proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current sanitizer blame and shell-utils history point to this owner path most strongly.
